title: Impact of Scale-dependent Primordial Non-Gaussianity on Scalar-induced Gravitational Waves
summary: Scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) probe primordial curvature perturbations beyond cosmic microwave background scales, while primordial black holes (PBHs) probe the rare tail of the same statistics. We ask whether SIGW morphology can reveal scale-dependent primordial non-Gaussianity. We adopt the internal-leg separable kernel, $\mathcal F_{\rm NL}(\mathbf{k};\mathbf q,\mathbf{k}-\mathbf q)=\bar f_{\rm NL}f(q)f(\lVert\mathbf{k}-\mathbf q\rVert)$, and compute Gaussian, reducible, and connected contributions through $\mathcal O(\bar f_{\rm NL}^{4})$ in the second-order tensor-source…
